name: Katta Glassblower’s Court
description: Glassblower’s Court is the glass‑craft and furnace‑work district of Katta Castellum. Glassblowers, arcane furnacewrights, and civic ornament artisans work in terraced studios regulated by guild oversight. The district produces household glassware, ceremonial vessels, arcane‑reinforced lenses, and decorative civic ornaments.
